Segnala offerta di lavoro About the Company Yibi Group is a leading OEM manufacturer and strategic partner for global luxury & fashion brands, certified by LVMH, Kering, and Richemont. With a massive 50,000㎡ precision manufacturing facility, we specialize in high-end hardware and jewelry components. We are now seeking a dynamic leader to join our digital marketing team to boost brand influence and drive business growth across the Italian and European luxury markets. About the Role We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager based in Italy (Milan, Rome, or Florence preferred, key luxury hubs) to lead digital marketing strategy and execution for Italian and European luxury clients. You will bridge our China-based headquarters and the Italian market, enhancing brand visibility and supporting business development through high-tech, data-driven marketing, aligned with Italian luxury industry norms. Responsibilities Strategy Execution: Develop and execute digital marketing strategies (Social Media, SEO/SEM, LinkedIn, Instagram, etc.) specifically tailored for the Italian and European luxury and premium hardware markets, catering to local consumer preferences. Campaign Management: Plan and optimize digital campaigns (both in English and Italian) to drive brand awareness and high-value client engagement, focusing on Italy’s luxury audience. Cross-Border Coordination: Coordinate between cross-functional teams (China & Italy) and act as a key contact for Italian digital marketing initiatives, ensuring smooth communication across time zones. Performance Tracking: Monitor campaign performance, provide data-driven insights, and ensure compliance with Italian and EU regulations (e.g., GDPR) and global luxury brand guidelines. Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of digital marketing experience in the luxury, jewelry, or high-end fashion industry (Italy/European market experience is essential; familiarity with Italian luxury brands is a strong plus). Technical Savvy: Proficient in digital marketing channels and tools (Google Analytics, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Instagram Business Suite, etc.). Global Collaboration: Experience collaborating with international teams across time zones (experience with China-based teams is a significant advantage). Language Skills: Fluent in English and Italian (written & spoken) – both are essential for client communication and internal coordination; Chinese (Mandarin) proficiency is a valuable bonus for cross-border collaboration. Required Skills Excellent client communication, problem-solving, and cross-cultural navigation skills, with a deep understanding of Italian business culture and luxury market etiquette. Strong analytical ability and attention to detail, capable of delivering under pressure in a fast-paced, luxury-focused environment. Ability to work flexibly across China/Italy time zones, ensuring effective coordination with the headquarters team. Equal Opportunity Statement Yibi Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, or disability, in compliance with EU and Italian equal opportunity regulations. At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Data-driven campaign management. Own acquisition campaigns for a product end to end—from hypothesis to launch, to iteration—running structured data-driven retrospectives to extract learnings and translating them into new creative solutions. Content creation. Leverage AI tools to produce high-performing, cross-channel visual content, directing hand-picked creators and writing tailored briefs to deliver the right message to each audience. Channels and partnerships. Coordinate the execution of campaigns across in-house production, external contributors, and client-facing advertising partnerships, working closely with creative, marketing, and business teams. Trend monitoring. Track social media trends, competitor activity, and emerging creative practices to stay ahead of the curve. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £47,660 to £68,579 in London and from €46,027 to €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £151,436 in London or €145,430 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time. Location Milan (Italy), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland). The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here. We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. Before you apply If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again. Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you. About this Job Location: Milan, Italy (Hybrid – 3 days/week in the office, 2 remote) Type: Full-time – with a clear path to Head of Marketing About Flottando Company cars are boring. We need someone crazy enough to make them exciting. 🚗 At Flottando we build AI software for corporate fleets. That means invoices, multe, fringe benefits, contract renewals and the Excel files that HR, Procurement and Finance trade back and forth every month. Hundreds of Italian companies already use us, and many of them are happy to tell their story. Now we need someone to go out and tell it, loudly. The role Let's be honest about this role. There's no marketing team waiting for you, no agency, no big budget and no brand guidelines. There's you, a laptop, a small and hungry founding team, and a product customers love. You'll write the post, film the video, book the guest, run the webinar, set up the event booth, send the follow-ups, and check on Monday whether any of it turned into pipeline. Then you'll do it again, better. If that sounds exhausting, this isn't for you. If it sounds like the best job ever, keep reading. Where this goes 🚀 You start as our first marketer. As Flottando grows in Italy and expands into Europe, you grow with it: you'll hire the team, own the budget and become our Head of Marketing. We're not hiring someone to fill a seat. We're looking for the person who will lead marketing here. What you will do • Call happy customers and turn them into case studies, videos and LinkedIn posts, starting in week one • Run our social channels yourself: writing, filming, editing, posting • Organize webinars and events from scratch, including topic, speakers, promotion, hosting and follow-up • Generate leads, hand them to sales, and track what becomes revenue • Launch our new AI products and make people understand why they matter • Do our employer branding so great people want to join us • Test, measure, kill what doesn't work and double down on what does • Challenge the founders. The CEO sets the strategy, and you push back when the data says otherwise Here's an example. In a demo, a fleet manager says she used to spend three days a month building cost reports in Excel. You hear it. You call her, record a 60-second video, turn it into a LinkedIn post, build a webinar around it, and check two weeks later how many demos it brought in. That's the mindset we're looking for. Who we are looking for You're probably a great fit if: • You're hands-on: you've done the work yourself, not just managed others doing it • You love startups: chaos, speed and building from zero excite you • You're entrepreneurial: you don't wait for a brief, a budget or permission. You ship • You're analytical: you care about leads and revenue, not likes • You're a strong communicator in writing, on camera and on stage • You're creative enough to make fleet management fun (yes, really) • You're high-energy and positive. People leave a call with you smiling Requirements • At least 1 year of hands-on experience in digital marketing with B2B SaaS products • Strong expertise in content marketing, SEO and GEO (getting found on Google and in AI answers like ChatGPT and Perplexity) • Strong experience with HubSpot: workflows, lead tracking, reporting • Native Italian, fluent in English • Bonus: experience at an early-stage startup or scale-up What we offer • RAL: 25k–38k EUR based on experience • A clear path to Head of Marketing, earned by results rather than seniority • Huge ownership from day one • A direct line to the founders, with no layers in between • AI at the foundation of our product, not as a buzzword • The chance to help build Italy's leading fleet platform and take it to Europe • A hybrid setup, with 3 days per week in our Milan office Hiring process We like to keep things simple, fast, and transparent. 01. Intro Call – 30 minutes Meet one of the founders. We'll talk about your motivation, what you've built so far, and what you're looking for. 02. Practical Case A short, real challenge: show us how you'd make Flottando impossible to ignore in the next 60-90 days from day 1 u join us. 03. Final Interview – 45 minutes: Walk us through your case with the CEO and the team. 04. Offer We aim to complete the process within 2–6 weeks. One last thing: We can teach you fleets, fringe benefits and how fines management work. What we're really looking for is harder to teach: Hunger. Ownership. Creativity. And the instinct to ship. If you read this and thought "finally, a job where I can just build," we'd love to meet you. Join Flottando and help us make fleet management exciting. Siamo una società AI-first , fatta di umani e agenti AI che lavorano insieme, nata con l'arrivo degli LLM e fully-bootstrapped: ci sosteniamo da soli e decidiamo noi cosa costruire. Il team Business Development trova le aziende e le qualifica; lo Strategist capisce il bisogno, chiude il progetto e lo coordina; i Trainer formano le persone (AI Academy), gli Engineer costruiscono agenti (AI Factory). 💰 Compensation Compensation totale annuale on target: €84.200-€101.600 RAL: €50.500-€57.000 in base alla seniority Buoni pasto e welfare: €2.500 l'anno Variabile annuale in base ai target del team €31.200-€42.100, uncapped, erogato trimestralmente Stock option disponibili 🔎 Le tue responsabilità Guidi un team di AI Strategist, da 4 a 6 persone, e rispondi dei risultati commerciali di tutto il gruppo. È un ruolo per chi ha già guidato un team e ha venduto e portato a termine progetti di trasformazione digitale o AI con il top management. Il ruolo comprende: Guidare e far crescere il team. Fai coaching, 1:1 e confronti periodici su obiettivi e risultati con ogni Strategist. Decidi chi entra nel team: i nuovi ingressi li intervisti e li approvi tu. Assegnare e chiudere i deal. Prendi le opportunità qualificate dal Business Development, ne apri di nuove con la tua rete e decidi quale Strategist segue ogni deal. Nei deal più complessi entri in prima persona, dalla discovery alla negoziazione. Tenere la relazione con i clienti del team. Per CEO e prime linee dei clienti del team sei il riferimento su prezzo, steering, rinnovi ed escalation. Trasformi il primo progetto in un rapporto che dura anni. Portare i progetti a risultato. Coordini il lavoro del team sui progetti di AI Academy e AI Factory insieme a Trainer ed Engineer, e intervieni quando tempi, scope o qualità escono dal piano. 📈 Il tuo percorso Nelle prime settimane conosci i clienti e i deal aperti del team e fai il primo 1:1 con ogni Strategist. Entro i primi 3 mesi guidi il team in autonomia. Hai fissato con ogni Strategist obiettivi e piano di crescita, e i nuovi deal li assegni tu. Dopo 12 mesi puoi accedere al livello successivo sulla base dei risultati del team e di criteri di performance quantitativi e trasparenti. 💛 Cosa offriamo Un posto in prima linea sull'AI. Lavori ogni giorno con gli strumenti più avanzati. La formazione che portiamo ai clienti è anche parte del tuo percorso: mentorship, peer learning e sessioni pratiche per rimanere sempre aggiornato sul mondo AI. Talent density. Lavorerai a fianco alle persone più forti sul tema più hot del momento, con un team giovane con zero ego, collaborazione, rispetto e feedback diretto. Crescita e impatto. Ogni ruolo ha un percorso di crescita scritto, da Junior a Head of, con criteri misurabili che conosci dal primo giorno: si cresce per risultati, non per anzianità. E si cresce in fretta, perché lavori in team piccoli con un impatto enorme e grande autonomia fin da subito. Retribuzione result-driven. La componente variabile è direttamente collegata ai risultati ed è senza tetto massimo : più valore generi, maggiore è il riconoscimento economico del tuo contributo. 🪜 Il processo di selezione Form online Intervista tecnica online Interview fit online Colloquio finale con CEO, in presenza a Milano 📍 Prima di candidarti Lavoriamo principalmente in presenza, nel nostro ufficio (Corvetto, Milano). Siamo una realtà early-stage con grandi ambizioni e crediamo che stare insieme, giorno dopo giorno, sia fondamentale per costruire energia, allineamento e risultati. Detto questo, operiamo con flessibilità e buon senso: il lavoro da remoto è possibile quando serve. Gli LLM sono arrivati tre anni fa e hanno creato un mercato nuovo. La finestra è grandissima ed è aperta adesso; per starci davanti bisogna lavorare meglio e più degli altri. Chi cerca ritmi prevedibili qui non sta bene. Serve l'italiano da madrelingua. I requisiti li scriviamo come orientamento, non come sbarramento: se il ruolo ti attira e pensi di poter crescere in fretta, candidati anche con un profilo non in linea. È già successo, ed è finita bene. For our office in Legnano (Milan), within our Business Unit Personal Care, we are looking for a passionate Brand Manager for our TENA Brand , responsible for the Italian market. This opportunity is offered as a 12-month fixed-term contract , providing the opportunity to manage the brand across a full annual business and marketing cycle. About The Role As Brand Manager Continence Care, you will manage the implementation of the Marketing Strategy for the TENA Brand in Italy, ensuring delivery of sales and market share targets through effective execution and alignment with global guidelines. The role reports directly to the Marketing Manager IT, IB & CH. Working in an international and dynamic environment, you will have strong exposure to Sales, Customer Marketing and global stakeholders, contributing to the development of one of Essity’s key brands. What You Will Do Drive brand growth and profitable market share development, contributing to brand and business performance. Contribute to lead annual brand and marketing planning and manage A&P budget allocation, ensuring accuracy, efficiency and alignment with global strategy. Execute brand campaigns and product innovations, track performance and manage the product lifecycle, including phase-in and phase-out activities. Manage assortment, pricing and product strategy in collaboration with global and cross-functional teams. Analyse market performance and consumer/customer insights, including Nielsen data, translating findings into actionable business and marketing initiatives. Support the definition and execution of media plans, with a focus on digital and paid media effectiveness. Who You Are University Degree in Economics, Marketing or a related field. Around 4 years of experience in Brand Management or similar Marketing roles within an FMCG environment. Previous experience in a multinational environment is highly valued. Fluency in Italian and English is mandatory. Good experience in the development and execution of marketing plans. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret market data and turn insights into actions. Hands-on knowledge of Nielsen or similar market data tools, together with Excel, PowerPoint, and AI tools. Strong collaboration skills and previous exposure to Sales and Customer Marketing. Proactive, autonomous and comfortable managing multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment. What We Can Offer You We offer a 12-month employment contract starting in January, with a gross annual salary starting from €36,000, in line with CCNL Carta Industria, Level B. The package also includes meal vouchers and an annual bonus. The role offers hybrid working, with up to two days of smart working per week. As the Legnano office is not easily accessible by public transport, having access to a car is recommended. Our purpose, Breaking Barriers to Well-Being, provides meaning to everything we do. Join us to improve well-being for people and drive positive change for society and the environment. At Essity, you'll feel valued, empowered to grow, and challenged to achieve business results in a collaborative and open atmosphere. Transform the everyday for everyone At Siemens, we enable sustainable progress through technology, connecting the real and digital worlds to improve how we live, work, and move. We put our people first - creating a diverse, global environment where you can grow, take ownership, and make a real impact from day one. Here, your ideas turn into innovative solutions that transform industries, infrastructure, mobility and everyday life. Your next chapter starts here! Your role: As a Marketing Professional – Digital & Vertical Marketing , you will be part of the EMEA Marketing Team , you will vertical marketing and digital demand generation in Italy translating industry insights, customer needs and business priorities into impactful marketing initiatives You will execute and localize Global and EMEA strategies , while developing Italian market-specific initiatives to address local business priorities and growth opportunities You will also act as a key point of reference for digital marketing performance across multiple EMEA countries , supporting KPI tracking, campaign measurement and performance optimization. This role combines strategic thinking, hands-on execution and a data-driven mindset in a dynamic, international environment. You’ll make an impact by: Develop and execute industry-focused marketing plans, translating market trends, customer needs and business priorities into targeted go-to-market strategies. Build a deep understanding of industry dynamics, customer needs, use cases, buying groups and decision-making journeys to identify growth opportunities and shape effective marketing programs. Define vertical-specific value propositions, messaging and content, translating technology capabilities into relevant customer outcomes and industry narratives. Drive and execute digital demand generation through integrated campaigns, customer journeys, ABM, paid media, content, email, webinars and marketing automation. Execute and localize Global and EMEA marketing programs for the Italian market, adapting propositions, content and activation to specific vertical and customer needs. Develop local vertical initiatives where market dynamics and business opportunities require a tailored approach. Partner with Sales and Business Units to prioritize industries, accounts, buying groups and use cases, connecting marketing activities to demand, pipeline and business growth. Leverage CRM, marketing automation and analytics to measure and optimize engagement, conversion, pipeline contribution and marketing ROI. Activate selected partners and ecosystem players to extend reach and strengthen vertical market penetration. Collaborate closely with EMEA and Global Marketing teams, contributing local market and industry insights, sharing best practices and ensuring alignment with broader marketing strategies. EMEA Digital Performance & Analytics: Act as a key point of reference across multiple EMEA countries for KPI definition, campaign tracking, performance dashboards and reporting, ensuring consistent measurement across markets. What makes you a great match: Core Requirements Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, or related fields. 5–6 years of experience in B2B marketing, ideally in technology, industrial or digital transformation environments. Experience in vertical/industry marketing, digital demand generation and integrated campaigns. Strong knowledge of digital marketing channels, ABM, customer journeys and marketing automation. Solid analytical skills and hands-on experience in digital performance measurement, KPI tracking, dashboarding and campaign optimization. Experience with CRM, marketing automation and digital analytics platforms. Ability to translate market insights and performance data into actionable marketing strategies. Strong business orientation, with an understanding of marketing contribution to pipeline and revenue. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across international, cross-functional and multicultural teams. Ability to balance Global/EMEA strategies with local market needs, effectively executing central programs while developing local initiatives when required. Fluent English and Italian Preferred Requirements Experience working with industry vertical marketing approaches and segment-specific go-to-market strategies. International working experience or exposure to global marketing environments Curiosity for emerging technologies, market trends, and innovative marketing approaches that support business growth. Awareness of Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in marketing, including content creation, campaign optimization, customer engagement, analytics, and productivity enhancement. Curiosity and willingness to explore emerging AI-powered tools and technologies to improve marketing effectiveness and business outcomes. Comfortable operating in matrix and international environments. Strong collaboration and influencing skills. What you’ll benefit from: At Siemens, we foster a results-driven and trust-based environment, offering a flexible hybrid working model that supports both performance and work-life balance. You’ll have access to a comprehensive wellbeing ecosystem, including dedicated parenthood support, health reimbursement programs, and psychological support services. Our welfare offering is designed to enhance overall quality of life, while continuous learning opportunities enable your ongoing personal and professional growth. The Total Target Cash (Base + Variable) Pay Range for this position is € 55.000 – € 70.000 annually. The actual offer will be determined within this range, based on the candidate’s experience, knowledge, skills, and qualifications. No company car. Your Uniqueness, Our Strength We celebrate the uniqueness of every individual and the value that diverse perspectives bring. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. At Siemens, we are an equal opportunity employer, hiring based on skills, experience, and potential, and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We encourage you to share your preferred working conditions: while this role is typically full-time, flexible arrangements can be discussed. Our recruiting team looks forward to getting to know you! Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials at affordable prices. With a presence in more than 100 countries, Pandora jewellery is sold through around 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores worldwide. At Pandora, we are committed to delivering unforgettable consumer experiences, strengthening cultural relevance, and driving sustainable business growth through impactful brand storytelling and commercial excellence. Job Purpose As Brand Senior Manager , you will play a pivotal role in orchestrating and bringing to life Pandora's marketing strategy across channels, functions, and markets. Acting as a trusted partner to local and global stakeholders, you will ensure the effective planning, coordination, and execution of integrated marketing campaigns that maximize brand excitement, consumer engagement, and commercial performance. You will lead campaign governance, commercial alignment, and cross-functional collaboration, translating global priorities into locally relevant initiatives while ensuring executional excellence across all consumer touchpoints. Main Activities Campaign Planning & Performance Management Own and coordinate the local Marketing Campaign Calendar, ensuring alignment with global priorities and local commercial objectives. Lead quarterly, monthly, and weekly campaign planning and review meetings to drive alignment, prioritization, and execution readiness. Monitor campaign and marketing performance against targets, proactively identifying risks, opportunities, and corrective actions. Provide regular performance insights and recommendations to the Marketing Director and local leadership team. Commercial & Cross-Functional Alignment Serve as the key marketing partner for Sales, E-commerce, and Merchandising teams on campaign planning and execution. Ensure consistent alignment on priorities, timing, customer experience, and business objectives. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to maximize campaign impact across channels. Global Stakeholder Management Act as the primary interface with Global Marketing teams. Consolidate local market insights, business priorities, and feedback to support global campaign planning and development. Prepare structured reporting and recommendations for global planning, tracking, and performance review meetings. Campaign Orchestration & Execution Lead the end-to-end local campaign implementation process. Define and manage a structured implementation calendar including milestones, governance meetings, feedback loops, and cross-functional checkpoints. Ensure flawless execution and timely delivery across all channels and stakeholders. Creative Excellence & Content Strategy Drive the local adaptation of global campaign concepts across paid, owned, and earned touchpoints. Define master creative layouts and execution guidelines for online and offline channels. Own the creative content strategy for Pandora's Facebook page, ensuring consistency with campaign narratives, brand guidelines, and engagement objectives. Ensure creative coherence across all consumer touchpoints and customer journeys. Brand Activation & Consumer Engagement Lead the development and execution of local brand activations and market-specific initiatives. Translate global platforms into culturally relevant experiences that resonate with local audiences. Identify opportunities to enhance consumer engagement, brand relevance, and commercial performance. Budget Management Manage marketing investments within the area of responsibility. Monitor overall campaign-related budget allocation and spending effectiveness. Ensure resources are aligned with commercial priorities and Marketing Director guidance. Share best practices and effectiveness learnings across Cluster markets. Cluster Coordination Align the Marketing Campaign Calendar across Cluster countries. Integrate local business requirements while maintaining consistency and coordination across markets. Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing between countries. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Like-for-Like Revenue Growth (shared responsibility) Gross Margin performance (shared responsibility) Brand Health and Brand Equity Metrics Campaign Effectiveness & Execution Excellence Consumer Engagement Metrics What We're Looking For Education Master's Degree in Marketing, Consumer Insights, Data Engineering, Business Administration or related fields. Experience Minimum 8 years of experience in Marketing, Brand Management, Campaign Planning and/or Consumer Insights. Minimum 3 years of people management and leadership experience. Experience working in complex international and matrix organizations. Strong understanding of both Brand Marketing and Performance Marketing. Experience managing integrated campaigns across multiple channels. Skills & Competencies Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills. Strong commercial and business mindset. Outstanding organizational and project management capabilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Data-driven and analytical approach to decision-making. Strong communication and presentation skills. Collaborative leadership style. High level of self-awareness and adaptability. Customer-centric mindset with high standards of quality and execution. Languages Fluent English and Italian, both written and spoken. What We Offer Permanent employment contract "Quadro" under the Italian Commerce Collective Labour Agreement (CCNL Commercio). Competitive salary: between €70,000 and €75,000 gross per year, depending on experience and qualifications. Annual performance bonus. Meal vouchers. Access to Pandora's welfare and wellbeing programmes. Employee discount on Pandora products. Additional birthday leave. Development opportunities within an international and fast-growing organization. Do you enjoy shaping new possibilities? At Accenture, you can help reinvent entire industries, working with the world’s leading companies. You’ll put your expertise to work to shape the future of business and technology, developing cutting-edge solutions that can create new value. Your role and opportunities As a Marketing Measurement Software Sales Manager , you will drive growth for advanced marketing measurement and analytics solutions, helping clients improve marketing effectiveness, optimize investments and turn data and insights into better business decisions. Lead consultative sales conversations with senior stakeholders across Marketing, Commerce, Finance, Analytics, Revenue, Data and Technology, identifying business challenges and translating them into relevant software and analytics opportunities. Position advanced marketing measurement capabilities, including Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), incrementality, unified measurement, forecasting, optimization and scenario planning, connecting them to measurable business outcomes and ROI. Manage the end-to-end software sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through solution positioning, demonstrations, proposals, negotiation and closing. Collaborate with product, analytics, data science, industry and technology specialists to shape solutions addressing challenges such as fragmented measurement, disconnected data and the need for faster, more reliable decision-making. Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to role, level, seniority, responsibility, skillset, and level of experience. For this position, the job level is A1 under the Metalmeccanico National Collective Bargaining Agreement. The gross annual salary range is between 50.000€ and 78.500€. Your Qualifications At least 6 years of overall professional experience, including 3+ years in software sales. Bachelor’s degree or higher. Experience in marketing measurement, marketing technology (MarTech), analytics or related software solutions. Good understanding of MMM, MTA, incrementality, sales or brand lift, and unified measurement. Proven experience managing consultative software sales cycles and engaging senior business stakeholders. Strong ability to translate complex measurement and analytics capabilities into clear business value and ROI. Fluent Italian and English. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with MarTech, AdTech, CRM, CDP, retail media, identity, clean rooms and cloud analytics ecosystems. Experience with marketing optimization, forecasting and scenario planning. Experience developing executive-level business cases around marketing and commercial investments. At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Chapter Lead __ Your Role And Responsibilities We are looking for a Marketing Specialist to join the Buying Opportunities EcoSystem agile team. In this role, you will drive marketing initiatives that support business growth by combining campaign excellence, marketing technology adoption, SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), data-driven decision making, and emerging AI capabilities. You will help translate business objectives into impactful marketing programs that enhance customer engagement and deliver measurable results. Working closely with your agile team members and wider business stakeholders across eCommerce, analytics and data, you will identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness, optimize processes, and scale best practices globally, while driving the adoption of data-driven and AI-powered solutions that enhance efficiency and business outcomes. Work model: Hybrid ( hybrid) You will be mainly accountable for: Developing, executing, and optimizing marketing campaigns aligned with business objectives, driving engagement, lead generation, and conversion. Partnering with stakeholders across the business to translate strategic priorities into impactful marketing initiatives and measurable outcomes. Collaborating across agile teams to capture demand, identify opportunities, and prioritize marketing, MarTech, and AI initiatives that deliver business value. Supporting in driving adoption and effective use of marketing technologies, ensuring alignment with global standards, processes, and best practices. Identifying, validating, and implementing AI use cases that improve marketing effectiveness, efficiency, customer engagement, and business outcomes. Monitoring and analyzing marketing performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations to improve effectiveness and ROI. Supporting agile team and marketing chapter members through guidance, training, and sharing of best practices across campaign management, SEO/GEO, marketing technology, AI, and emerging digital marketing practices. Ensuring compliance with ABB policies, AI governance requirements, GDPR, and data privacy regulations across all marketing activities. Qualifications For The Role 10+ years of experience in marketing, preferably within industrial B2B environments, with a proven track record of developing and executing successful digital marketing programs and campaigns. Strong expertise in digital marketing disciplines including, SEM, paid media, marketing automation, analytics, lead generation, and customer journey optimization. Drive adoption of SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) practices across marketing teams, helping improve ABB’s visibility and discoverability across traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences. Hands-on experience with MarTech platforms such as Salesforce, Pardot and related marketing technology tools. Demonstrated practical experience with AI in marketing, including the use of Large Language Models (LLMs), AI assistants, agents, automation workflows, and generative AI tools to improve marketing performance and productivity. Strong analytical and business acumen, with the ability to leverage data, identify opportunities, measure impact, and translate insights into action. Fluent English. More About Us ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. This opportunity is open to candidates in one or more countries covered by the European Pay Transparency Directive. The final work location will depend on the selected candidate. As pay may vary by location, compensation details will be shared with candidates who progress to the first interview stage. Segnala offerta di lavoro The opportunity We are looking for an experienced Brand & Content Lead to join Cegeka's Group Marketing & Communications organisation and play a key role in shaping how our brand is positioned, expressed and experienced across our European markets. In this role, you will lead Cegeka's brand identity, content strategy and key creative production, setting editorial standards and helping make our brand consistent, distinctive and visible across Industries, Service Lines and Geographies. You will turn strategy into compelling stories, campaigns and assets that strengthen our positioning and support business growth. This is a senior leadership position within Brand & Communications, combining strategic brand thinking with content and creative leadership, people management and strong collaboration across a complex international organisation. What You'll Do Lead brand strategy and guardianship, helping develop and apply Cegeka's positioning, narrative, identity and messaging, while creating effective brand standards, frameworks and reusable assets. Drive content and editorial strategy, setting editorial priorities and guiding enterprise content, thought leadership and customer proof that support our strategic growth priorities. Provide creative direction, leading the development of brand campaigns and priority assets across design, video, media and copy. Lead and develop the team, coaching the Design Manager and Content & Editorial Manager and guiding the wider creative community. Manage creative partnerships, defining briefs, requirements and quality standards for agencies and freelancers and overseeing delivery within agreed engagements. Work across the organisation, partnering with Growth Marketing, M&C Operations & Channels, Reputation & Relations, Communications & Engagement and other stakeholders across Industries, Service Lines and markets. Use insights to improve our impact, defining relevant brand and content measures and using audience, brand and content insights to continuously improve campaigns and assets. What You Bring We're looking for a senior Brand & Content professional who combines strategic thinking with the ability to turn ideas into high-quality creative output. You ideally bring: 7+ years of relevant experience in brand, content or creative leadership, preferably within B2B technology, IT services, consulting or a similarly complex international environment. Strong experience in brand strategy, positioning and architecture, including brand guidelines and governance. Proven expertise in editorial and content strategy, including thought leadership and customer proof. Experience providing creative direction across design, video and copy. Experience working with creative agencies and external partners. Strong people leadership experience, including leading managers and creative professionals. Experience working successfully in a matrix, international and multi-country environment. Confidence working with senior and executive stakeholders. Fluent English, written and spoken. Knowledge of Italian or another language is considered an advantage. A bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business or a related discipline. Nice to have Experience with CMS, DAM or marketing technology ecosystems. Experience with AI-enabled and Generative AI content workflows. Experience in multi-brand or complex B2B organisations. Video, motion or event content production experience. Exposure to employer branding or internal communications. Experience in a marketing or operating-model transformation. What Will Make You Successful You are a strategic storyteller and a coaching leader. You know how to combine structure with creativity and are comfortable navigating complex organisations where different teams, markets and priorities need to come together around a shared brand. You are collaborative, commercially minded and resilient in changing environments. Just as importantly, you can move comfortably between strategic conversations with senior stakeholders and hands-on reviews of creative work and content. Why join us? This is an opportunity to help shape the brand of a European IT group at an important stage of transformation, working on topics such as AI and digital sovereignty and collaborating with colleagues and senior stakeholders across Europe. You will have significant visibility across the organisation and the opportunity to influence how our brand, stories and creative work come together across markets, Industries and Service Lines. Working model Location : Italy: Remote-first , with no fixed office requirement. Our offices in Italy are in Cologno Monzese (MI), Rome, Gallarate (VA), Casalecchio di Reno (BO) and Padua. Employment : Full-time, payroll. Team : Group Marketing & Communications, working with colleagues across Europe. Language: Fluent English required; another language (Italian) is an advantage. Salary range: €80K–€110K gross per year, plus meal vouchers and additional benefits. For our office in Legnano (Milan), within our Business Unit Personal Care, we are looking for a passionate Brand Manager for our TENA Brand , responsible for the Italian market. This opportunity is offered as a 12-month fixed-term contract , providing the opportunity to manage the brand across a full annual business and marketing cycle. About The Role As Brand Manager Continence Care, you will manage the implementation of the Marketing Strategy for the TENA Brand in Italy, ensuring delivery of sales and market share targets through effective execution and alignment with global guidelines. The role reports directly to the Marketing Manager IT, IB & CH. Working in an international and dynamic environment, you will have strong exposure to Sales, Customer Marketing and global stakeholders, contributing to the development of one of Essity’s key brands. What You Will Do Drive brand growth and profitable market share development, contributing to brand and business performance. Contribute to lead annual brand and marketing planning and manage A&P budget allocation, ensuring accuracy, efficiency and alignment with global strategy. Execute brand campaigns and product innovations, track performance and manage the product lifecycle, including phase-in and phase-out activities. Manage assortment, pricing and product strategy in collaboration with global and cross-functional teams. Analyse market performance and consumer/customer insights, including Nielsen data, translating findings into actionable business and marketing initiatives. Support the definition and execution of media plans, with a focus on digital and paid media effectiveness. Who You Are University Degree in Economics, Marketing or a related field. Around 4 years of experience in Brand Management or similar Marketing roles within an FMCG environment. Previous experience in a multinational environment is highly valued. Fluency in Italian and English is mandatory. Good experience in the development and execution of marketing plans. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret market data and turn insights into actions. Hands-on knowledge of Nielsen or similar market data tools, together with Excel, PowerPoint, and AI tools. Strong collaboration skills and previous exposure to Sales and Customer Marketing. Proactive, autonomous and comfortable managing multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment. What We Can Offer You We offer a 12-month employment contract starting in January, with a gross annual salary starting from €36,000, in line with CCNL Carta Industria, Level B. The package also includes meal vouchers and an annual bonus. The role offers hybrid working, with up to two days of smart working per week. As the Legnano office is not easily accessible by public transport, having access to a car is recommended. Our purpose, Breaking Barriers to Well-Being, provides meaning to everything we do. Join us to improve well-being for people and drive positive change for society and the environment. At Essity, you'll feel valued, empowered to grow, and challenged to achieve business results in a collaborative and open atmosphere. We are a global leader in the design, manufacture, and distribution of ophthalmic lenses, frames, and sunglasses. We offer our industry stakeholders in over 150 countries access to a global platform of high-quality vision care products (such as the Essilor brand, with Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest and Transitions), iconic brands that consumers love (such as Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear and Costa), as well as a network that offers consumers high-quality vision care and best-in-class shopping experiences (such as Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, Salmoiraghi & Viganò and the GrandVision network), and leading e-commerce platforms. Join our global community of over 190,000 dedicated employees around the world in driving the transformation of the eyewear and eyecare industry. Discover more by following us on LinkedIn ! Your #FutureInSight with EssilorLuxottica Are you willing to pioneer new frontiers, foster inclusivity and collaboration, embrace agility, ignite passion, and make a positive impact on the world? Join us in redefining the boundaries of what’s possible. Your role We are seeking a Digital Performance Marketing Specialist with strong expertise across performance channels to support the execution and optimization of data-driven growth initiatives. The role will focus on driving measurable results across Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, and retail media, with a specific focus on Amazon's advertising and operational ecosystem. We are looking for a candidate who combines hands-on media buying excellence with strong analytical curiosity and a deep understanding of retail media data architecture to build advanced measurement frameworks that go beyond standard platform reporting. Main responsibilities: Retail Media Leadership: Strategy, execution, and scaling of full-funnel Amazon campaigns, leveraging Sponsored Ads (Sponsored Products, Brands, Display) and Amazon DSP to drive incremental growth. Advertising Data Strategy & AMC: Utilize Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) to build advanced measurement models, track cross-channel path-to-purchase journeys, analyze incrementality, and develop custom audience segments. Retail Operations Alignment: Bridge advertising strategies with Amazon retail operations, continuously aligning ad spend with inventory health, Buy Box ownership, glance views, and catalog dynamics. Multi-Channel Campaign Management: Execute and optimize performance marketing campaigns across Search, Social, and Display to hit core KPIs (ROAS, CPA, and Revenue). Advanced Measurement & Analytics: Support the development of sophisticated measurement frameworks, such as custom attribution models, lifetime value (LTV) analysis, and New-to-Brand (NTB) acquisition strategies. Data Synthesis & Reporting: Analyze and interpret complex retail and media datasets to guide budgeting, forecasting, and cross-functional performance recommendations. Main requirements: 2–3+ years of hands-on experience managing full-funnel Amazon ad strategies, including Sponsored Ads and Amazon DSP. Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) Expertise: Demonstrated experience using AMC to uncover custom retail media insights, develop custom attribution frameworks, and build first-party target audiences. Amazon Retail Operations Knowledge: Solid understanding of Amazon Vendor Central/Seller Central logistics and operations, including inventory forecasting, Buy Box dynamics, catalog management, and organic vs. paid synergy. Paid Media Track Record: Proven experience across Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, and Paid Social platforms (Meta, TikTok). Analytical Mindset: Strong ability to connect retail operations data with ad performance to make strategic, revenue-driving decisions. Communication: Clear ability to translate complex advertising data, AMC queries, and retail trends for non-technical stakeholders. What’s in it for you In EssilorLuxottica, you are not defined just by your job title. Each career adventure is unique; have a glimpse of some of the benefits you will enjoy as a successful candidate: Access to our cutting-edge learning platform, Leonardo, and personalized development programs to help you grow professionally and personally. Enjoy flexible work conditions, health insurance coverage, ticket restaurants, internal rooftop canteen Join the Corporate Shareholding Program “BOOST” an opportunity to share in the company’s success and directly benefit from EssilorLuxottica’s growth. Access special offers for employees on a vast range of eyewear, eye care products, and fashion apparel, so you can enjoy our world-class brands firsthand. Enjoy our “Disconnect Program” a holistic approach to work-life balance, including initiatives for mental health, yoga, jogging sessions, and more, designed to help you recharge and stay healthy. testo_completo: Milan, Italy Hybrid Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Luxembourg office. About us Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance . That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of. What you'll be doing As our Finance Operations Specialist, you’ll be the person who ensures the smooth daily operativity of the finance team, owning a broad set of operational processes, from reconciliations to month-end close, and making them more efficient through automation. Here's what that looks like in practice: Finance Operations Ownership - Run and continuously improve the team’s day-to-day operational processes, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and compliance with internal controls. Reconciliation - Own bank, payment-provider and ledger reconciliations end to end: match transactions, investigate breaks and make sure balances are accurate and explained at every month-end close. Process Design from Scratch - Define and build new processes where none exist, reconciliations included: map the flows, set controls, document procedures and establish clear ownership and escalation paths. Process Automation & Scripting - Write and maintain Python scripts to automate reconciliation, matching and other routine tasks, reducing manual work and increasing daily efficiency. Strategic Support - Collaborate with the Finance Team and internal stakeholders to support new projects, ensuring operational alignment with tax, accounting and treasury guidelines. Data Analysis & Reporting - Extract, manipulate and analyze financial data to monitor open items, report on process status and optimize treasury processes. Who we're looking for This role needs someone who is a problem-solver who loves teamwork, gets things done, and is ready for real ownership. Background - Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Management, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field. Experience - 3+ years of hands-on experience in finance operations or accounting, including reconciliation, and ideally in setting up or improving operational processes. Technical Proficiency - Solid, proven experience with Python and scripting applied to data manipulation, automation, or API integrations. Financial Systems Knowledge - Good understanding of accounting principles, ERP systems, bank reconciliation and month-end close workflows. Core Skills - Detail-oriented with strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills to handle tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Language Proficiency - Fluent in English and Italian. Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply. CareAbout: how we support your impact We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout: ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops. 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries. ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply. 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours. 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness. *We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time. Segnala offerta di lavoro Job Description STRATEGIC MARKETING ASSOCIATE MANAGER Short Description Calling all strategic thinkers and beauty enthusiasts! If you have a passion for Skincare and Derma, a love for the wider world of Haircare, Body Care, Personal Care and Fragrances, and want to make a tangible impact on brand strategies and product portfolios, this role is for you! As our new Strategic Marketing Associate Manager – Care & Scent, you'll join the Strategic Marketing Care & Scent team, a dynamic and creative group working with the most strategic and innovative brands in the market. You'll report directly to the Strategic Marketing Senior Manager Care & Scent and work side by side with Business Units, Business Development and international teams. Your playground is the full Care & Scent universe, with a specific focus on skincare and derma, alongside body care, hair care, sun care, personal care and fragrance. Your deep knowledge of dermocosmetics and skincare science will turn our innovation into compelling, credible stories. From day one, you'll drive client promotion, shape product plans and help decode the trends that will define skincare and derma. Where you'll make an impact 1 Win the world's most strategic beauty brands Clients: Product Promotion & Portfolio Strategy New Business Generation: Team up with Business Development to open new business opportunities with strategic clients across Europe. Brand Analysis & Client Intelligence: Get to know every key client inside out: their line-up, positioning, portfolio performance and strategic priorities. Use brand and competitive analysis to spot exactly where our innovation can add the most value. Targeted Innovation Promotion: Hand-pick the innovations that matter most to each client and turn formula, ingredient and technology advances into tailored, engaging presentations and selling stories. Scientific Storytelling: Bring skincare and derma innovation to life with scientific credibility: active ingredients, mechanisms of action, delivery systems, efficacy testing and claim support. Become the trusted expert clients turn to. Events & Client Visits: Plan, organize and run institutional events, trade fairs and client visits, including all related relationship-building, and make sure every meeting turns into concrete opportunities. You're the one we're looking for if… Languages: You speak and write English and French fluently. This is essential. Derma & Skincare Expertise: You have proven experience in skincare marketing, ideally with dermocosmetic, clinical or pharmacy brands or a cosmetic manufacturer, and strong knowledge of skin science, active ingredients and efficacy claims. International Mobility: You're happy to travel across our reference markets in Europe. Passion for Beauty: You live and breathe cosmetics and industry trends, and you follow beauty news, scientific publications, launches and social media. The Circle and the Square: You balance creativity with scientific rigor, data intelligence and a strategic mind, and you're at ease combining quantitative and qualitative data to build strategies and guide decisions. Attitude: You're creative, curious, ambitious and results-oriented, and you thrive managing multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced international environment. Excellent Communicator: You're a confident presenter and a natural relationship builder, creating fluid, trustworthy and positive connections with clients and cross-functional teams. What's In It For You A team that moves fast: Join a dynamic, creative group where curiosity and initiative are noticed and rewarded with responsibility. Shape the Future of Beauty: Play a key role in developing and promoting innovative product strategies for leading brands. Global Impact: Work in an international environment with frequent travel across EMEA, collaborating with top-tier clients. Where: Olgiate Comasco (CO), Italy Ready to take your passion for beauty and strategy to the next level? Join our team and help define the future of Care & Scent. Apply today! Your Responsibilities For more than 100 years, our mission has been to make people's lives healthier and safer. We achieve this through innovation. As pioneers in technology, we design and deliver solutions across our Medical and Scientific divisions that make a positive contribution to society. Our products are essential for advancing scientific research and helping healthcare professionals diagnose, treat and prevent diseases. In the medical field, we develop and manufacture state-of-the-art technologies for diagnosis and therapy, ranging from endoscopes to electrosurgical devices. We are looking for a Senior Sales Manager – GI-ET/RESP to join our organization in Italy, based in Milan. Reporting directly to the Cluster Business Unit Leader GI-ET/RESP, the successful candidate will be responsible for leading commercial activities across Italy, coordinating the direct team of Territory Managers and the network of sales agencies operating nationwide. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on commercial management, with overall responsibility for driving sales performance and business growth in Italy, strengthening customer relationships and ensuring the achievement of commercial objectives, in close collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Sales Strategy & Business Development: Define and implement the national sales strategy, identify business growth opportunities and translate strategic priorities into clear commercial action plans to achieve sales and business objectives. Sales Team Leadership: Lead, coordinate and develop the direct team of Territory Managers, fostering collaboration, accountability and a strong results-oriented mindset. Agency Management: Coordinate and support sales agencies operating across Italy, ensuring alignment with the company's commercial strategy and business objectives. Budget & Performance Management: Take full ownership of sales performance, budget achievement and commercial execution across ET (GI & Respiratory) in Italy, ensuring effective forecasting, KPI management and timely corrective actions. Customer Relationship Management: Develop and strengthen relationships with strategic customers and key stakeholders, including healthcare decision-makers and scientific associations. Tender & Negotiation Management: Oversee public tender processes and commercial negotiations, coordinating the Sales Force and Back Office in collaboration with the Marketing Team. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Technical Service and other internal stakeholders to translate business strategy into effective commercial initiatives, product launches and field execution, while ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. Events & Scientific Engagement: Coordinate the organization and management of congresses, training courses and other events across the country. Your qualification University degree preferred, ideally in business, economics, life sciences or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Extensive experience in sales and sales management roles within the medical device or MedTech industry. In-depth knowledge of the Italian healthcare market and public administration. Proven experience in public tender management and commercial negotiations. Proficiency in written and spoken English. Willingness to travel nationwide according to business needs. Your competencies Strong leadership and people management skills, with experience coordinating sales teams and indirect sales networks. Strong business acumen and results orientation, with the ability to translate strategy into actionable plans. Excellent negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills. Strong analytical skills and experience managing budgets, KPIs and commercial performance. Excellent organizational skills, flexibility and the ability to manage complex situations and work under pressure. Your Benefits Joining Olympus means contributing to a mission that puts people's health at the center, while working in an international, innovative and collaborative environment. We are committed to supporting our employees' professional development, wellbeing and work-life balance. Compensation Package: Employment under the Italian Commerce Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL Commercio), with an annual gross salary .paid over 14 months instalments, comprising a fixed component and a variable component. The final compensation package will be determined based on the candidate's professional experience, skills and level of autonomy, ensuring alignment with the role and internal pay equity. Company Car: A company car for both business and private use, provided as part of the benefits package for employees in business and field-based roles. Social Benefits: Access to company initiatives and benefits designed to support employee wellbeing and contribute to a positive working environment. Career Growth & Development: Opportunities for professional growth within the company, supported by mentoring programmes, personalized career development plans and regular performance reviews. Birthday Leave: One additional paid day off on your birthday, giving you the opportunity to celebrate your special day with your loved ones. Learning & Development: Access to training courses, workshops, e-learning platforms and opportunities to attend industry conferences and events, supporting continuous professional and personal development. Corporate Volunteering: Opportunities to participate in corporate volunteering initiatives and contribute to social and environmental responsibility projects, making a positive impact on the community. Psychological Support: Access to a professional and confidential psychological support service, offering guidance and assistance during challenging personal or professional situations and promoting emotional wellbeing and work-life balance. At Olympus, we believe in the value of people, collaboration and innovation to improve patients' lives. If you are ready to leverage your commercial expertise and leadership skills in a meaningful, high-impact industry, we look forward to hearing from you! Il focus del ruolo sarò quello di strutturare e governare l’azione commerciale attraverso pipeline, forecast, KPI e CRM, supportare la gestione dei clienti chiave e delle negoziazioni più rilevanti, e favorire una collaborazione efficace con le funzioni interne (Customer Service, Smart Factory, Marketing, Technical Sales). In un contesto a forte respiro internazionale, la figura contribuirà a consolidare il posizionamento sul mercato e a promuovere opportunità legate allo sviluppo di soluzioni e servizi a valore aggiunto. Responsabilità principali: Gestione strategica delle vendite: implementazione della strategia con la Direzione Commerciale; definizione e monitoraggio di budget/forecast e piani di sviluppo; presidio di segmenti/territori. Sviluppo business e portafoglio: coordinamento delle attività su acquisizione e sviluppo; penetrazione di nuovi segmenti; supporto alla crescita del portafoglio prodotti/soluzioni/servizi in base alle esigenze di mercato; promozione di soluzioni Smart Factory/Engineering Service. Leadership e people development: definizione obiettivi e KPI; review periodiche; valutazione performance e piani di sviluppo; coaching/affiancamento; promozione di una cultura orientata a collaborazione, responsabilità, customer focus e risultati. Processi commerciali: qualità dati e utilizzo del CRM; gestione pipeline e accuratezza del forecast; miglioramento continuo; coordinamento interfunzionale; supporto all’esecuzione di iniziative commerciali/promozionali. Requisiti: Laurea/Master (Economia, Ingegneria o equivalente). Esperienza in ruoli di coordinamento commerciale B2B, preferibilmente nel settore della componentistica industriale, della viteria e sistemi di assemblaggio o in contesti manifatturieri. Esperienza nella gestione di clienti strategici e negoziazioni complesse. Approccio strutturato su KPI, utilizzo CRM, project management e coordinamento multifunzionale. Ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali. Inglese fluente per interazioni in contesto internazionale. Disponibilità a trasferte sul territorio nazionale per circa il 50% del tempo. This role is for Ignition Italia Srl , an Exclusive Networks Company. We are seeking an experienced Senior Vendor Business Development Manager to drive the growth and development of the CrowdStrike business in Italy. The successful candidate will take ownership of the vendor relationship from a business development and channel perspective, working closely with CrowdStrike, channel partners and internal teams to accelerate revenue growth, pipeline generation and market penetration. This is a key role within the Italian business, combining strategic account management, partner development and commercial execution. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of the cybersecurity market, proven experience in channel sales and the ability to build and execute joint go-to-market strategies with a strategic technology vendor. Key Responsibilities Own and execute the go-to-market strategy for CrowdStrike in Italy, in close alignment with the vendor and Ignition's business objectives. Develop and maintain a strong and strategic relationship with CrowdStrike, acting as a key point of contact and ensuring alignment on business priorities, targets and joint initiatives. Build, manage and continuously develop a high-quality commercial pipeline, with a strong focus on new business generation, revenue growth and partner activation. Identify, recruit, develop and manage strategic channel partners, increasing their engagement and capability to position and sell CrowdStrike solutions. Drive joint business plans and go-to-market initiatives with key partners and CrowdStrike, translating strategic objectives into measurable commercial actions. Develop and execute partner enablement initiatives, including business planning, sales activities, campaigns and commercial programs. Work closely with Ignition's presales and technical teams to support partners and customers throughout the sales cycle and strengthen the technical and commercial positioning of CrowdStrike solutions. Identify market opportunities, emerging trends and competitive dynamics within the Italian cybersecurity market and translate them into actionable business opportunities. Monitor and manage key KPIs, including pipeline, revenue, forecast, partner activation, opportunity progression and business growth. Own regular business reviews and forecasting activities with both internal stakeholders and CrowdStrike. Collaborate closely with Sales, Presales, Marketing, Operations and Finance to ensure effective execution and alignment across the business. Work with the Marketing team to develop and execute demand-generation and market-development initiatives focused on increasing CrowdStrike awareness, pipeline and revenue. Ensure consistent communication and visibility across all stakeholders, proactively identifying risks and opportunities and driving corrective actions where required. Represent Ignition and CrowdStrike at relevant industry events, partner meetings and customer engagements across Italy. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE | About You Minimum 7 years of experience in Business Development, Channel Sales or Account Management within the cybersecurity and/or technology industry. Proven experience working with cybersecurity vendors and channel partners in the Italian market. Strong understanding of the Italian channel ecosystem, including distributors, resellers, integrators and MSSPs. Experience managing strategic vendor relationships and executing joint go-to-market strategies. Demonstrated track record of building pipeline, developing new business and delivering revenue growth. Strong commercial and business acumen, with the ability to translate strategy into measurable business results. Excellent relationship-building, negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders at vendors, partners and customers. Strong presentation and influencing skills, with the ability to communicate business value to both commercial and technical audiences. Highly organised, proactive and autonomous, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. Data-driven and results-oriented, with strong analytical and forecasting capabilities. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, international and matrix organisation. Fluent Italian and English, both written and spoken. Willingness to travel within Italy and occasionally internationally as required. A highly visible role with direct exposure to a leading global cybersecurity vendor and its channel ecosystem. A dynamic and international working environment.
