Segnala offerta di lavoro Job Description Business development is central to this role. The Business Development Manager (BDM) will promote and specify Tridium’s Niagara products to end users, influencers and technology partners across multiple vertical markets. Based in Italy, ideally Milan, and reporting to the Head of EMEA Sales, the BDM will take direct ownership of key customer relationships primarily across Italy, with additional responsibility for neighboring Western European territories and selected relationships across the wider EMEA region. The role includes managing existing customers, but its primary focus is identifying new territories, vertical markets and customer opportunities, then developing them into long-term users of Tridium products. Responsibilities Act as the primary customer interface for developing new business and building relationships that support growth across Tridium EMEA. Create and own regional plans and strategies that expand the customer base and increase sales. Communicate key messages, initiatives and the value Tridium brings to target customers, opportunities and solutions. Drive sales by understanding each target customer’s business, organisation and commercial drivers, and by clearly articulating Tridium’s value. Build partnerships with prospective customers and maximise the business potential for both parties. Work closely with assigned Account Managers to maintain a unified One Team approach. Qualifications Customer development: Identify prospective customers, develop them into direct or indirect customers, and transition established accounts to the appropriate regional sales teams. Relationship ownership: Take responsibility for customer relationships across the region, both internally and externally, and build connections with key stakeholders at all levels. Market strategy: Contribute to Tridium’s strategy and implementation through market research and business development. Planning: Prepare and maintain business development plans for each new account, including territory, opportunity and customer-specific pursuit strategies. Pipeline growth: Maintain a strong focus on new customers and opportunities, delivering orders and margin above the agreed quota in support of the Annual Operating Plan. Forecasting and systems: Keep the CRM and other relevant databases current and provide accurate forecasts of orders and growth opportunities to support EMEA reporting and sales management. Collaboration: Participate in team meetings and company events, contribute regularly to sales meetings, and coordinate with BDMs in other regions. Business Relationships: Develop new customer relationships and engage stakeholders at every level, including senior leaders. Become involved early in the buying process to uncover customer needs that Tridium can address. Sales Process: Continuously identify new sales opportunities and provide consultative support by building compelling customer value propositions. Develop customer contacts and serve as the focal point for relationship strategies, sales plans, proposal strategies and contract negotiations for active pursuits. Customer Engagement: Engage technical, economic and relationship buyers, including executive-level decision-makers. Pursue opportunities valued over $100k+ including opportunities in which Tridium holds a competitive advantage. Cross-Functional Leadership: Mobilise the right resources to address customer priorities and initiatives. Coordinate management and executive-sponsor engagement with new customers. Results: Deliver profitable growth by winning new customers and opportunities, while achieving orders and margin above the agreed quota in support of the Annual Operating Plan. We offer Annual gross salary from 63.300 EUR and applicable NCBA is Metalmeccanico Grande Industria. Final salary offer will depend on your experience and qualifications and are also based on objective and gender-neutral criteria. Recognition & referral bonus programs. In-house and external learning platforms supporting development opportunities Global employee networks to help you connect and grow. Access Integrity line - Any workplace issues or violations that need to be raised in good faith, can be communicated in a safe, private and confidential environment Frequent Employee Engagement activities fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. Hybrid work arrangement to support your work-life balance. Monetary contribution for meals for everyday worked. Employees are eligible for a structured productivity bonus tied to overall business performance and results. Company car. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. Join a team recognized for leadership, innovation, and diversity. About Us Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy. La società italiana è una realtà in fase di startup , nata con l'obiettivo di avviare e sviluppare il mercato italiano. Fa parte di un importante gruppo internazionale , presente in quasi 20 paesi e attivo nel settore dell' innovazione e dello sviluppo tecnologico . L'azienda sviluppa e commercializza soluzioni innovative nei settori della realtà virtuale e aumentata, della simulazione, della robotica e della formazione immersiva, rivolgendosi a imprese e organizzazioni di diversi settori. La figura selezionata avrà un ruolo centrale nello sviluppo della presenza commerciale in Italia , contribuendo all'acquisizione di nuovi clienti, all'apertura di nuove opportunità di business e alla crescita della società sul mercato nazionale, con particolare attenzione alla Lombardia . Principali responsabilità: Sviluppo commerciale e acquisizione di nuovi clienti nei settori della Pubblica Amministrazione, dei Beni Culturali, dell'audiovisivo e del turismo. Sviluppo di relazioni commerciali con Regioni, Comuni, musei, soprintendenze, fondazioni, parchi, università e altri enti e istituzioni. Acquisizione di clienti nel settore audiovisivo e turistico, tra cui case di produzione, broadcaster, agenzie di eventi, destinazioni turistiche, parchi tematici e operatori dell'hospitality. Promozione e vendita di esperienze immersive, installazioni multimediali e contenuti XR (Extended Reality) come strumenti di attrazione, valorizzazione e generazione di ricavi. Sviluppo di opportunità commerciali attraverso gare pubbliche, affidamenti diretti e collaborazioni con enti e istituzioni. Individuazione e monitoraggio di bandi e opportunità di finanziamento pubblico, accompagnando i clienti nella definizione dei progetti e delle relative esigenze. Coordinamento con l'ufficio gare e i team tecnici per la preparazione e la presentazione delle offerte commerciali. Gestione dell'intero ciclo di vendita, dalla prospezione alla negoziazione e chiusura dei contratti. Monitoraggio della pipeline commerciale, del fatturato, dei margini e delle previsioni di vendita. Gestione delle attività nel CRM e reporting periodico alla Direzione. Requisiti: Esperienza nella vendita di sistemi audiovisivi, rivolti ad aziende, musei, eventi e istituzioni. Capacità dimostrabile di acquisire nuovi clienti, gestire trattative complesse e raggiungere obiettivi commerciali. Esperienza nella gestione di cicli di vendita articolati, con interlocutori diversi e tempi di negoziazione medio-lunghi. La conoscenza del mercato della Pubblica Amministrazione, dei Beni Culturali e delle procedure di gara costituisce un importante plus. Buona conoscenza del tessuto economico e istituzionale del Nord Italia. Italiano madrelingua e conoscenza professionale dell' inglese ; la conoscenza dello spagnolo costituisce un plus. Patente B e disponibilità a trasferte frequenti sul territorio nazionale. Residenza nell'area di Milano o disponibilità a raggiungere quotidianamente la sede. Ottime capacità relazionali, negoziali e organizzative, autonomia operativa, orientamento ai risultati e attitudine allo sviluppo commerciale. Si offre: Contratto a tempo indeterminato. Rise Search ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Rise Search. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Livello retribuzione di base 45.000,00 €/yr - 60.000,00 €/anno Per conto di una solida e dinamica realtà italiana con sede nell’area Est di Milano, attiva da oltre 15 anni nella fornitura di tecnologie, componenti e soluzioni impiantistiche per l'industria di processo, stiamo ricercando una figura di Technical Sales / Area Manager per lo sviluppo e la gestione del mercato Italia. L’azienda è una PMI parte di un gruppo italiano ed opera come partner tecnologico per importanti realtà manifatturiere italiane e internazionali, proponendo soluzioni ad elevato contenuto ingegneristico sia attraverso la distribuzione esclusiva di prestigiosi marchi esteri, sia tramite lo sviluppo di sistemi personalizzati supportati da un proprio reparto interno di Ricerca & Sviluppo. Posizione La figura selezionata, rispondendo direttamente alla Direzione Commerciale, avrà la responsabilità di sviluppare e consolidare il portafoglio clienti sul territorio nazionale, gestendo l'intero processo di vendita tecnico-consulenziale. Principali responsabilità: Sviluppare nuove opportunità di business e gestire/fidelizzare il portafoglio clienti attivi nell'ambito dell'industria manifatturiera e di processo su territorio italiano. Analizzare le esigenze tecniche e produttive degli interlocutori aziendali (Responsabili di Produzione, Uffici Tecnici, Engineering, Manutenzione e Acquisti), individuando la soluzione tecnica più idonea. Collaborare attivamente con l’Ufficio Tecnico interno per la definizione delle specifiche progettuali, l'organizzazione di eventuali test applicativi e la formulazione delle offerte tecnico-economiche. Condurre le trattative commerciali fino alla chiusura dell'ordine, assicurando un supporto costante anche nel post-vendita in sinergia con il team di assistenza tecnica. Partecipare alle principali fiere di settore per promuovere le tecnologie e le soluzioni aziendali. Requisiti Formazione tecnica (Diploma di Perito Meccanico/Elettrotecnico o Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, Chimica o Gestionale) o esperienza equivalente maturata nel settore industriale. Esperienza pregressa di almeno 3-5 anni in ruoli commerciali tecnico-consulenziali (Sales Engineer, Area Manager, Technical Sales) nella vendita B2B di componenti, macchinari o impianti per l'industria di processo, il manufacturing o l'automazione industriale. Buona capacità di lettura del disegno tecnico e comprensione dei cicli produttivi industriali. Spiccata attitudine relazionale, proattività, orientamento al risultato e ottime doti negoziali. Disponibilità a trasferte frequenti sul territorio italiano ( circa 50% del tempo ) Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese per il confronto con i partner tecnologici internazionali. Cosa offre l'Azienda: Inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato in un contesto innovativo e in costante crescita. Possibilità di gestire soluzioni tecnologiche di alto livello, con il supporto di un ufficio tecnico e di un'area R&D interna. Pacchetto retributivo: RAL fascia 45.000/60.000 + parte variabile legata al raggiungimento degli obiettivi + auto aziendale. Sede di lavoro: Provincia di Milano (area Est) con operatività sul territorio nazionale. Livello retribuzione di base 27.000,00 €/yr - 30.000,00 €/anno Hays PLC, società quotata al London Stock Exchange, è uno dei leader mondiali nel Recruitment specializzato in ambito Junior, Middle e Senior Management. Oltre 9.500 professionisti compongono il team Hays worldwide, con uffici dislocati in 23 Paesi e 6 divisioni specializzate. In Italia siamo presenti a Milano, Roma, Bologna e Torino e offriamo ogni giorno interessanti opportunità di lavoro nei diversi settori di mercato. Il tuo nuovo ruolo Per il nostro team Marketing di Milano siamo alla ricerca di un/una Marketing & Communications Specialist. La risorsa avrà la responsabilità di gestire e sviluppare le attività di Marketing e Comunicazione per il mercato italiano, con particolare focus su social media, creazione di contenuti e analisi di mercato. Parallelamente, collaborerà con il Marketing Team Southern Europe, contribuendo con competenze e insight di Market Research a progetti e iniziative che coinvolgono Italia, Spagna e Portogallo. Nello specifico, ti occuperai di: Marketing & Communications - Italia Gestire le attività locali di social media e content marketing; Individuare trend di mercato e trasformarli in contenuti rilevanti e iniziative di thought leadership; Gestire i canali social organici, occupandoti anche del piano editoriale e del community management; Creare contenuti digitali come video, GIF e reel, collaborando con il Creative Designer Southern Europe per la produzione e l'editing degli asset; Gestire attività di paid media su LinkedIn e Instagram; Preparare e adattare materiali di marketing a supporto di iniziative HR, commerciali e campagne locali; Supportare campagne, eventi, attività di sales enablement e comunicazione interna; Supportare le attività locali di PR, in coordinamento con il Marketing Manager e il team Southern Europe; Monitorare performance e KPI di marketing, traducendo i risultati in insight e azioni concrete; Gestire le piattaforme di job advertising, garantendo il corretto funzionamento delle pubblicazioni e la risoluzione di eventuali problematiche. Market Research - Southern Europe Collaborare con il Market Research Hub Southern Europe, contribuendo all'identificazione di trend, insight e opportunità sui mercati italiano, spagnolo e portoghese; Portare expertise e insight relativi al mercato italiano nei progetti regionali, contribuendo alla realizzazione della Salary Guide e di altre iniziative di ricerca. Caratteristiche del candidato ideale Cerchiamo una persona con esperienza in ambito Marketing, Comunicazione, Social Media e/o Content Marketing, interessata a un ruolo operativo e trasversale all'interno di un contesto internazionale. La risorsa ideale possiede un forte interesse per il Market Research e per l'utilizzo dei dati come base per sviluppare insight e iniziative di marketing. Completano il profilo ottime capacità di project management e stakeholder management, proattività, autonomia operativa, capacità di collaborazione e un approccio hands-on. Cosa ti serve per avere successo Esperienza in Marketing, Comunicazione, Social Media e/o Content Marketing; Interesse e conoscenza delle attività di Market Research e analisi dei dati; Ottime capacità organizzative e di project management; Capacità di gestire e collaborare con diversi stakeholder; Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana e inglese; Conoscenza degli strumenti Adobe e di piattaforme per l'adattamento e la localizzazione di materiali di marketing; Approccio proattivo, collaborativo e orientato ai risultati; La conoscenza di Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) rappresenta un plus. Cosa avrai in cambio L'opportunità di entrare a far parte di una realtà internazionale leader nel proprio settore; Un percorso di formazione continuo, attraverso corsi e iniziative formative sia a livello italiano sia internazionale; La possibilità di lavorare all'interno del Marketing Team italiano e, allo stesso tempo, collaborare con il team Southern Europe, condividendo competenze e contribuendo a progetti regionali; Un contesto dinamico, internazionale e orientato al raggiungimento di obiettivi e KPI; Smart working fino a 2 giorni a settimana; Welfare aziendale e Ticket Restaurant; RAL: 27.000€ - €30.000. Job Profile Summary Develops and oversees standard technology specifications, data structures and content for specific products. Responsible for development and support of publishing technologies, and the collection and selection of content. Responsible for the design, development and support of electronic products with regards to both content and technology ramifications. Job Description About the Role: As a Senior Content Management Analyst, you'll be a pivotal force behind our digital content strategy. Leveraging your expertise, you'll manage content projects, and ensure seamless collaboration among team members. Your work will directly impact our brand's online presence and user experience. Responsibilities: Lead content projects from planning to execution in collaboration with publishing and technology teams Collaborate with designers and developers for content structuring. Ensure the CMS is utilized effectively to manage content. Maintain and update content guidelines and best practices. Train and mentor junior team members in content management. Research emerging trends to keep content relevant. Monitor and resolve issues with web content promptly. Manage and keep contact with local and corporate suppliers Skills: Project Management: Ability to manage content projects (knowledge of tools like Jira, Confluence, Asana..) Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro ABOUT WEROAD: CONNECTING PEOPLE, CULTURES, AND STORIES Founded in 2017, WeRoad is a fast-growing startup that is disrupting the travel industry in Italy, Spain, UK, Germany, France, Switzerland and… the USA! With 200 team members and 4K Travel Coordinators, we’re a community of travelers who turn every trip into a life-changing experience. We connect like-minded millennials and send them on adventures to 1000+ destinations worldwide. We're on a mission to design and deliver experiences worth living and sharing, through rewriting the rules of the travel industry. Sounds exciting? Before you apply, please read through our Cultural Manifesto 👥 About The Role JOB TITLE: Content Marketing Specialist - USA LOCATION: Milan (Hybrid) TYPE OF CONTRACT: Fixed term of a year to start with - full time 40hrs/week SALARY RANGE: 25k-28k Starting date: December/January (the sooner, the better) We want real American energy on our U.S. Instagram, and we're looking for the person who brings it, from our HQ in Milan. You'll join WeRoad's global Content team, the same people who run our Italian, Spanish, French and German profiles. The U.S. profile follows our global editorial plan: your job is to make it sound and feel truly American, and to own everything that happens in real time, from Stories to trends to the U.S. point of view. Strategy is set by the Content Marketing Manager, you bring the ideas, the content and the voice. This role isn't about years of experience. We're looking for someone sharp, tech savvy, and already great at making content, who wants to grow fast with a team around them. This is an individual contributor role, with no people management involved. What You'll Do Own WeRoad U.S. Stories every day: ideate, shoot, edit and publish. You're the face and the voice of the profile. Adapt hooks, captions and formats of our global content so they land with an American audience. Pitch U.S.-specific content and bring U.S. insights into our editorial plan. Engage with other accounts, creators and communities to grow a real American audience. Spot trends before they peak and turn them into on-brand content, fast. Cover WeRoad moments (events, Reunion, trips) for a U.S. audience, and join WeRoad trips to create content on the road. Help put together the monthly U.S. profile report: what worked, what didn't, what's next. Community management: you own the profile and feel it as if it was yours. You engage with the community, reply to comments and engage with other profiles with the WeRoad’s tov. What we’re looking for: You have lived and worked in the US and know the American market inside out, from consumer behavior to the content, tone, and trends that resonate with US audiences. You'll be our eyes and ears on the US from Milan, helping our content marketing team create stories that feel truly local. American English is your native language. You think in it, meme in it, create in it. Knowledge of the Italian language is a plus. You've made content before, ideally for a brand and not only for your own channels. Show us your work, we care about it more than your CV. Comfortable in front of the camera and behind it, with a strong eye for aesthetics. Tech-savvy and fast: Canva, AI tools, video editing (CapCut, Premiere, whatever you use). Every piece of content you make has a reason: you know what it's for and how to tell if it worked. You love working in a team: you take a plan, make it better and bring your own ideas to the table. Based in Milan or ready to move here, with the right to work in Italy. TikTok know-how and a feel for analytics are a plus. You will love working at WeRoad if: You dream big, aim higher, and push yourself beyond limits you didn’t think possible. Challenges excite you, and you’re hungry for the next win. You want to be part of a young, smart, and fun team that shares your passion for travel. You thrive in a community of bold thinkers and doers who challenge and inspire each other. You’re an entrepreneur at heart, take responsibility from day one, and move fast to make things happen. You prefer adventure over routine and embrace the fast-paced, ever-changing ride of a scaleup. You make decisions quickly, test, learn, and adapt—because growth comes from action. You believe in the power of people. Our WeRoaders and Travel Coordinators are at the core of everything we do, and you’re eager to be part of something bigger. What we can offer Performance-based bonus – A discretionary annual variable bonus, and based on performance and company results. A free WeRoad trip every year – Choose your dream destination with €1,400/year travel discount or travel even more as a Travel Coordinator. Trust-based holidays – We believe performance is driven by impact, not by hours at a desk. You are encouraged to take the time you need to recharge, beyond contractual minimums, within shared guidelines. Opportunities to learn – We invest in your growth with training and learning opportunities. New parent support – €3,600/year for 3 years after birth or adoption (or prorated if your child is under 3 when you start at WeRoad). Extra benefits – Meal vouchers (€8/day – when applicable), a €1,000 bonus for your wedding or civil union, and one-off bonus when you hit 5 years with us. Fun – A vibrant co-working space, team buildings and meet-ups. Hybrid working - Flexible working, and we support you to work from your destination of choice up to 1 month per year. Ready to apply? At WeRoad, cultural fit matters as much as skills. We assess both the what, what someone brings and the how, how they work and live our values. With multiple steps, we make sure every new joiner is not just a match, but 150% aligned with our Culture. The Selection Process Will Consist Of introductory call with Talent Acquisition Lead technical and background-based interview with Hiring Manager Case Study/ Second technical interview Culture Champions step WeRoad is an equal opportunity employer: we consider for employment all applicants, regardless of their race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, family status, political affiliation, disability, and any other legally protected characteristic. Statistically speaking, women are less likely to apply for roles where they don't fit the job description perfectly. Don’t let a checklist hold you back: if you’re passionate about the role we encourage you to apply with enthusiasm! Job Description About the role: As Trade Marketing Specialist (m/f/d) , you will play a key role in turning commercial agreements into clear, structured, and ready-to-activate media plans . Working closely with internal teams and external stakeholders , you will coordinate timelines, campaign assets, and planning requirements to ensure every campaign is prepared efficiently and in line with defined standards . With a strong focus on accuracy, collaboration, and operational excellence , you will support smooth planning processes and enable a seamless handover to Activation teams . In this role, you will contribute to consistent campaign readiness and help drive the successful execution of Retail Media initiatives . About your tasks: Translate commercial agreements into structured media plans, enabling effective campaign execution and clear operational alignment Define campaign structures, formats, and product selection in line with planning guidelines and campaign objectives Coordinate campaign setup with internal teams and external partners, ensuring alignment on timelines, requirements, and deliverables Manage asset requests and creative briefings, ensuring campaign materials are complete, accurate, and available on time Prepare campaigns for handover to Activation teams, ensuring full campaign readiness and smooth transition into execution Monitor timelines, dependencies, and planning milestones to ensure campaigns are delivered as planned Coordinate promotional activities with internal stakeholders, ensuring consistency with broader commercial and media initiatives Maintain accurate documentation and planning data, ensuring transparency, consistency, and reliable campaign tracking Qualifications About you: Bachelor or Master Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field 1–3 years of experience in digital advertising, campaign management, media planning, or a similar role Good understanding of retail media and campaign planning processes Ability to translate commercial input into structured media plans and campaign setups Strong coordination and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple timelines, dependencies, and stakeholders High attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in planning data, campaign structures, and asset requirements Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams and external partners A structured, organized, and reliable working approach, especially in a dynamic and cross-functional environment Additional Information About your benefits: In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs – whether it’s living a healthy life, having enough time for your needs, or developing your skills – we offer a wide range of different, site-specific benefits: Welcome days: We want you to feel comfortable from day one and welcome Mental health: Get quick professional help from psychologists from nilo if you feel overwhelmed in your personal or professional life. Anonymously and free of charge.. Smart working: When your job doesn’t require you to be onsite, we arrange hybrid work schedules with the possibility of working remotely. Redcare Events: We can only grow together. Training and personal growth: We encourage continuous learning and growth through internal and external trainings and workshops. Employee discount: Of course you will have discounts in our webshop.
